title: This is not white!
text: This is not white!. I want white for spring not "off-white" or "cream," so whoever called this white, please look at this blanket side by side with white. I have an old white blanket, it is WHITE. Again, this color is not white. If you stick this on a bed with all white, this looks very stupid. It feels soft to the touch, but I can't speak to how it would wear or wash as I will return it. I bought a gray one of these from another company. I would have bought from them as that throw has washed 100 times without fail, but they have no white either.  This is always very inconvenient, but the cost of buying online.
